card.name: Words just before restrict/restriction
card.fires_on: Short linking or modifier words right before a form of "restrict" or "restriction" is expected, such as "to", "a", "these", "dietary" or "largely". It fires on the word before the restriction term, not on the term itself.

modes.label: Before restrict as a verb
modes.description: A small word where the next word is likely a verb form of restrict.
modes.example: Use your programs' settings<< to>> restrict content

modes.label: Before restriction as a noun
modes.description: A modifier or determiner where the next word is likely "restriction(s)", often for diet or fluids.
modes.example: No diet or<< water>> restriction is necessary.

modes.label: Before restricted as an adjective
modes.description: An adverb where the next word is likely "restricted" to a region or group.
modes.example: but now<< largely>> restricted to the Southern Hemisphere

card.writes: It boosts a few odd non-English tokens and suppresses the restrict/restriction word forms, so it works against repeating that word.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before the word "restrict" or "restriction" is likely to appear.
